entities.name: Vojislav Ilić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vojislav Ilić was a Serbian poet, known for his finely chiseled verse. His poetry exemplifies a classic example of modern Serbian language and features the standard Decadent motifs of the epoch: cruel nature, and the times of Elagabalus.
